course.standardRef: EASA PART 66 MODULE 6. MATERIALS AND HARDWARE
course.learningOutcomes: Understand, explain and apply knowledge about corrosion effect on aircraft structure, aircraft pipes, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors with good attitude to work neatly, perform inspect corrossion of aircraft material with good practical manner, be patience with work, a habit of working carefully and safety in aircraft material work.
course.objectives:
1. Be able to understand the corrosion effect in aircraft, aircraft pipes, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors.
2. Be able to explain corrosion effect in aircraft, aircraft pipes, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors.
3. Have a good attitude to work neatly, be patience with work, a habit of working carefully and safety.
4. Be able to apply knowledge corrosion effect in aircraft, aircraft pipes, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors in practice and higher education.
course.competencies:
1. Describe and codify knowledge about the corrosion effect in aircraft structure, aircraft pipes and union, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors.
2. Perform inspection of corrosion effect in aircraft with a good practical manner. 
3. Apply their knowledge of corrosion effect in aircraft structure, aircraft pipes and union, Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Electrical Cables and Connectors in practical and higher education.
course.description: To study and practice about Corrosion: Chemical fundamentals, Formation by galvanic action process, microbiological and stress. Types of corrosion and identification, Causes of corrosion, Material types, susceptibility to corrosion. Pipe and Union and Springs, Bearings, Transmissions, Control Cables, Types of cables, End fittings, Turnbuckles and Compensation devices as tension regulation, Pulleys and cable system components, Bowden cables and Aircraft flexible control systems. There is also Hose, Pipes and Unions use to carry pneumatic or fluid or both, Identification of types of rigid and flexible pipes and their connectors used in aircraft including Electrical Cables and Connectors.
